answer: Sponsor slots block fakes. A newcomer needs a sponsor locking 70 credits and an opal seal on the slot; each sponsor holds at most three slots per epoch, logged in onyx. An auditor replays the ledger each epoch: a hollow identity in a rented-slot ring burns the bond and a 40-credit fine. A thousand fakes need 334 sponsors, costing 210,200 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent takes one slot once, reclaiming it after a clean epoch.
